welcome.title: Welcome to Cypher Guide
welcome.subtitle: 100% P2P Decentralized Homestay & Travel Booking Network
welcome.description: Cypher Guide is the first autonomous P2P travel platform removing traditional intermediaries (OTA platforms). Guests and Hosts communicate via Nostr Protocol, pay via Bitcoin Lightning / Cashu eCash, and operate under 7 synchronized Tokenomics pillars.
welcome.feat2: 2-Way Escrow Deposit & Up to 86% fee reduction based on Nostr Reputation
welcome.feat3: Mint Proof-of-Stay Badge (NIP-58 SBT), Referral Sats Rewards & Node Infrastructure Rewards
welcome.userRoleHint: Suitable for Guests, Hosts, Referrers, and Node Operators.

lodgings.title: 1. Stays Tab (Lodgings)
lodgings.subtitle: Explore Homestays, Bookings & Tokenomics Discounts
lodgings.description: Where guests browse homestays, view details, and initiate P2P booking contracts with 2-Way Escrow Deposits and Reputation-based fee optimization.
lodgings.feat1: Pay for rooms with Lightning Invoice (BOLT11) or Cashu Zero-Knowledge eCash
lodgings.feat2: 2-Way Escrow Deposit: Locks 10% Guest deposit & 10% Host deposit for collateral
lodgings.feat3: Up to 86% protocol fee discount for Cypher Legend accounts (Nostr Rep >= 85)
lodgings.userRoleHint: Click the "Become a Host" button if you want to list a new homestay.

trips.title: 2. Trips Tab (My Trips)
trips.subtitle: QR Check-in, Deposit Refunds & Proof-of-Stay NFT Minting
trips.description: Stores all your bookings. Generate encrypted QR Check-in codes, automatically release deposits upon Checkout, and mint Proof-of-Stay NFT Badges (SBT).
trips.feat1: Encrypted QR Check-in with Nostr keys & smart door lock rotation (IoT)
trips.feat2: Automatically releases 100% 2-Way Escrow deposit back to Lightning wallet upon Checkout
trips.feat3: Automatically mints immutable Proof-of-Stay NFT Badges (NIP-58) on Nostr
trips.userRoleHint: For Guests to track trips, unlock smart doors, and claim back escrow deposits.

messages.title: 3. Messages Tab (Direct Messages)
messages.subtitle: End-to-End Encrypted Chat Channel (E2EE NIP-04)
messages.description: Direct communication between Guest and Host with total privacy. All messages are encrypted via ECDH algorithms with Nostr keypairs.
messages.feat2: Exchange door access codes, check-in times, and exact coordinates
messages.feat3: Authenticate sender identity using Nostr Schnorr digital signatures
messages.userRoleHint: Contact Host immediately after booking to receive check-in instructions.

governance.title: 4. Governance Tab (Governance & Multi-sig)
governance.subtitle: Tiered Governance, Insurance Fund & BFT Dispute Resolution
governance.description: 3-Tiered governance (Tier 1 Mesh, Tier 2 Host Co-Owners, Tier 3 BFT Council). Manage Multi-sig Insurance Fund and resolve Escrow disputes via 2/3 BFT Quorum.
governance.feat1: Transparent Tiered Governance based on share weights & reputation
governance.feat2: Multi-sig Insurance Fund automatically accumulated from transaction fees
governance.feat3: Decentralized dispute resolution using 2/3 Byzantine Fault Tolerance Quorum
governance.userRoleHint: Hosts and Shareholders can initiate Proposals and vote directly.

identity.title: 5. Identity Tab (Identity & Referral Sats)
identity.subtitle: Nostr Identity, AI Audit & 1% Referral Sats Rewards
identity.description: Manage Nostr keypairs, check Cypher Agent AI Reputation score, earn 1% Referral Sats commission when inviting friends, and showcase Proof-of-Stay Badge NFTs.
identity.feat1: Track Referral Sats earnings (1% per booking) with instant Lightning withdrawal
identity.feat2: Collection of accumulated Proof-of-Stay Badge NFTs (NIP-58 Soulbound Tokens)
identity.feat3: AI Reputation Audit: Automated reputation scoring based on transactions & contributions
identity.userRoleHint: Backup your secret nsec key and copy your personal Referral Link to start earning Sats!

mesh.title: 6. Mesh Network Tab (Mesh & Node Rewards)
mesh.subtitle: Topology Relays & Infrastructure Node Incentives
mesh.description: Visual topology map showing Homestay Nodes, Nostr Relays, and Infrastructure Node Incentives for operators maintaining Uptime.
mesh.feat1: Automated Sats rewards for Nostr Relay & Mesh Gateway operators maintaining >99.9% Uptime
mesh.feat2: Track latency and WebSocket connections across 8 core Nostr Relays
mesh.feat3: Real-time monitoring of P2P broadcast message flows
mesh.userRoleHint: Check Mesh network connectivity status and earn Sats if running a Node.

guide.title: 7. Guidebook Tab (Guide & Tokenomics)
guide.subtitle: Architecture & 7-Pillar Tokenomics Cycle
guide.description: Complete guide on protocol architecture, synchronized 7 Tokenomics Pillars diagram, Lightning wallet setup, and beginner user handbook.
guide.feat1: Detailed overview of the 7 synchronized Tokenomics Pillars system-wide
guide.feat2: 1-minute setup guide for Lightning Address wallets (Alby, Wallet of Satoshi)
guide.feat3: Explaining P2P terms, Nostr NIPs, Cashu Ecash & Zero-Knowledge
guide.userRoleHint: Look up knowledge and protocol overview diagrams whenever needed.

guide.title: Architecture & Unified Tokenomics Cycle Protocol
guide.subtitle: Cypher Travel - P2P Autonomous Travel & Mesh Infrastructure Protocol
guide.overviewTitle: Optimized UX/UI - Direct connection between Guests, Hosts, Relay Nodes & BFT Governance Council
guide.overviewDesc: All modules on Cypher Guide operate independently of central servers. Data is verified instantly via Schnorr Cryptographic Signatures (Nostr NIP-01) and Lightning / Cashu Ecash Payment Networks.

p1.title: Multi-Sig Insurance Fund & BFT Dispute
p1.desc: Insurance fund automatically accumulates from transaction fees. Disputes are resolved by the Arbitrator Council achieving 2/3 BFT Quorum with Schnorr signatures.

p2.title: Proof-of-Stay Badge NFT (NIP-58)
p2.desc: Upon successful checkout, the system automatically mints a Soulbound Badge (SBT) containing verified stay data. Required for submitting reputation reviews.
p2.uiLoc: My Trips Tab & Identity Tab (Nostr ID)

p3.title: Reputation-Based Fee Discounts
p3.desc: Cypher AI Agent automatically analyzes transaction history & contributions to award Reputation scores. Cypher Legend rank users receive up to 86% protocol fee discount (down to 0.2%).
p3.uiLoc: Booking Modal & Reputation Audit in Identity Tab

p4.title: 2-Way Escrow Lock Deposit
p4.desc: Both Guest (10%) and Host (10%) post collateral deposits. Automatically unlocks Host deposit upon successful check-in and Guest deposit upon clean checkout.
p4.uiLoc: Booking Modal & Checkout button in My Trips

p5.title: Real Referral Sats (1% Per Booking)
p5.desc: Share your personal link ?ref=npub1.... Each successful booking automatically shares 1% Sats revenue directly to the referrer with instant wallet withdrawal.

p6.title: Tiered Governance
p6.desc: Clearly separates 3 tiers: Tier 1 Mesh (Relay & Heartbeat), Tier 2 Co-Owners (Rental prices & Host Multi-sig), Tier 3 Council (BFT Insurance Fund).

p7.title: Infrastructure Node Incentives
p7.desc: Pays Sats rewards from Protocol Fund to Operators maintaining local Nostr Relays and LoRa Mesh Gateways with verified Uptime & Routed Packets.
p7.uiLoc: Mesh Network Tab → Infrastructure Node Incentives Section

guide.philosophyQuote: "An autonomous travel system cannot be coerced or unplugged when identity belongs to the user (Nostr NIP-01), funds belong to personal wallets (Lightning / Cashu), and infrastructure is operated by a self-sovereign Mesh network."

mesh.title: Nostr Relays Network & Mesh Topology
mesh.subtitle: Monitor real-time connection status & latency to decentralized transit nodes (Nostr Relays).
mesh.guideTitle: DETAILED GUIDE ON MESH NETWORK & NOSTR RELAYS
mesh.overviewP1: Cypher Guide leverages the decentralized Nostr (Notes and Other Stuff Transmitted by Relays) protocol to power all lodging data, bookings, direct messaging, and governance voting.
mesh.overviewCard1Desc: No identity or message storage on centralized servers (Web2 Cloud). Data is signed with Schnorr signatures and distributed across Relays.
mesh.overviewCard2Desc: If 1 Relay goes offline, the application continues operating smoothly by automatically connecting in parallel to 6+ fallback Relays.
mesh.overviewCard3Desc: Integrated with Bitcoin Lightning Network allowing guests to pay Sats directly to Host Lightning wallets instantly.
mesh.relaysP1: Nostr Relays are lightweight WebSocket servers acting as entry and broadcast gates for messages between Guest and Host.
mesh.relaysCardTitle: How the Latency Test Panel Below Works:
mesh.relaysLi1: When clicking "Test Latency", the browser opens an actual WebSocket connection to the Relay's URL.
mesh.relaysLi2: Measures response time in milliseconds (ms). Lower ping (< 100ms) ensures smoother communication.
mesh.relaysLi3: You can add your own custom Relay (e.g., wss://my-relay.domain.com) in the input box below.
mesh.archK0Desc: Contains profile metadata, name, Lightning Address (LNURL).
mesh.archK4Desc: Private messages between Guest & Host encrypted via ECDH algorithm.
mesh.archK30001Desc: Lodging details, rental prices, photos & Homestay location data.
mesh.archK30020Desc: Governance voting proof and multi-sig shareholder fund withdrawals.
mesh.privacyDesc: Your secret nsec... private key stays safely inside your personal browser and is never transmitted over the network. All posts or messages are signed client-side before broadcast to Relays.
